function hourPrice(n,h){const base=FISHP[n]||1,sd=fHash(n),ph=(sd%628)/100;
  const d=Math.floor(h/24),hr=h-d*24,fr=x=>x-Math.floor(x),rn=k=>fr(Math.sin(sd*0.0137+d*91.7+k*37.1)*43758.5453);
  const c=Math.floor(rn(1)*24);let p1=Math.floor(rn(2)*24),p2=Math.floor(rn(3)*24);
  while(p1===c||Math.abs(p1-c)===1)p1=(p1+1)%24;while(p2===c||p2===p1||Math.abs(p2-c)===1)p2=(p2+1)%24;
  if(hr===c)return Math.round(base*.2*100)/100;
  if(hr===p1||hr===p2)return Math.round(base*100)/100;
  const x=Math.sin(sd*12.9898+h*78.233)*43758.5453,r=x-Math.floor(x);
  const w=Math.sin(2*Math.PI*h/6+ph)*0.45+Math.sin(2*Math.PI*h/2.3+ph*2)*0.15+(r-.5)*0.3;
  return Math.round(Math.max(.5*base,Math.min(.92*base,base*(.7+w*.35)))*100)/100}

function hAgo(ms,p){const s=Math.max(0,(Date.now()-ms)/1000),m=Math.floor(s/60),h=Math.floor(m/60),d=Math.floor(h/24),mo=Math.floor(d/30);
  if(m<1)return p+" لحظات";
  if(m<60)return p+" "+(m===1?"دقيقة":m===2?"دقيقتين":m<=10?m+" دقائق":m+" دقيقة");
  if(h<24)return p+" "+(h===1?"ساعة":h===2?"ساعتين":h<=10?h+" ساعات":h+" ساعة");
  if(d<30)return p+" "+(d===1?"يوم":d===2?"يومين":d<=10?d+" أيام":d+" يوم");
  return p+" "+(mo===1?"شهر":mo===2?"شهرين":mo<=10?mo+" أشهر":mo+" شهر")}
